ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark background with high-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, with higher density at the distal tips. A distinct white linear 'hook' mark is located in the inner-middle section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 70-80 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge; notably irregular and jagged topography at the far lateral tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curve tapering from the tips toward the median notch; the visible leading edges emerging from the water display a convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and annular high-intensity pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scars, most concentrated on the outer third of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several discrete, unaligned white linear markings visible on the left lobe, including one prominent multi-directional scar cluster near the lower-center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the fluke surface and irregular notches along the trailing edge indicative of historical parasitic load or minor mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense distribution of white ring-like scars creates a 'leopard-print' appearance across the dark pigmentation.
